name: ask-codex
description: A Claude Code plugin that turns OpenAI Codex into a teammate: delegate reviews, plans, refactors, and implementations to Codex over the local codex MCP server, with the model + reasoning effort matched to the task.

plugins.name: ask-codex
plugins.description: Delegate coding work from Claude Code to OpenAI Codex — review, plan, refactor, implement, or second-opinion — with the right model + effort per task. Includes the codex-teammate subagent for multi-turn loops.
